title: Rollout Configurator — Edit Mode visual specs, redlines, and stakeholder sign-off
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Finalize visual specifications, redlines, and QA checklist for the Rollout Configurator's Edit Mode (the modal and inline edit surface used by product owners to adjust percentage splits, model variants, and route targeting). Goal is a developer-ready handoff with annotated Figma screens, accessibility validations, and a list of follow-ups for engineering and PMs.

Background: The Rollout Configurator v2 introduces an inline edit flow to reduce context switching (previous flows relied on full-page editor). Stakeholders requested clearer affordances for fractional percentage edits, persistent validation states (sum != 100%), and compact banners when edits are staged but not deployed. This ticket collects the final visual polish pass and records review feedback across Design, PM, and Eng.

Scope:
- Annotated Figma frames for Edit Mode (modal + inline) with redlines for spacing, type scale, and micro-interactions.
- Toast and transient banner patterns for staged changes, validation errors, and successful deploys.
- Updated microcopy for percentage input, commit/cancel actions, and confirmation dialogs.
- Accessibility checks: color contrast, focus order, keyboard-only flow, and ARIA attributes for the percentage inputs and the live preview.
- QA checklist and acceptance criteria for design sign-off and engineering handoff.

Out of scope: full rollout orchestration logic, server-side validation rules beyond the UI-level checks, analytics event naming (handled in ENG-3499).
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames annotated with spacing, margins, and token references (type, color, elevation)
All redlines addressed and turned into a single 'visual-specs' PDF for the Eng team
Accessibility items verified in the design (contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 for body text, keyboard tab order defined)
Microcopy finalized and reviewed by PM
QA checklist created and linked to the handoff PR
Design sign-off by Product and Engineering architects
comments: 2026-02-26 — Maya Chen: Initial upload of annotated frames and first-pass redlines. Included three alternate micro-interaction options for the % input (stepper, inline edit, drag handle).

2026-02-27 — Evelyn Park: PM preference is inline edit with a left-aligned stepper fallback on mobile. Suggested changing 'Apply' label to 'Commit' to reduce ambiguity when multiple staged edits exist.

2026-02-28 — Jonah Reed: Engineering notes: avoid custom drag-handle if it requires new low-level pointer events; stepper + editable numeric field is preferred for cross-browser stability. Also called out need for deterministic animation durations to avoid layout shift (see ENG-3312).

2026-03-01 — Priya Nair: Accessibility review: flagged contrast issue on the muted help text (now updated). Requested explicit ARIA-live region for staged-change toasts and keyboard focus return to the originating row after modal close.

2026-03-02 — Maya Chen: Incorporated feedback: removed drag handle option, standardized on stepper + numeric input, updated microcopy to 'Commit changes' and added secondary 'Discard' action with destructive affordance. Created QA checklist and exported assets. Updated Figma link in attachments.

2026-03-03 — Tomoko Saito: Design lead redlines: tighten token spacing between percentage input and sparkline by 8px, increase interactive hit target to 44px min, and add a subtle success motion for deployed state (150ms fade + 120ms scale) — included animation spec.
2026-03-04 — Carlos Ortega: Preparing handoff bundle. Pull request created with visual-specs PDF and CSS token mapping. Requesting final PM sign-off before assigning to ENG-3499 for implementation.
